title: A new group's id comes from a typed only-rising counter, so it can never collide with a stored record
summary: Group ids allocated from a typed non-optional counter (seeded and checked only at restore), steps past every stored id, apply rejects an add over a taken id; 0 ids handed out twice and 0 ghosts on 15 paired runs; parity SOC-278, divergence 2.146 part 1.

title: A pair re-forms and leaves a group every two ticks: a contract-formed group is bound to its contract and its holder
summary: Contract-bound groups (holder, typed end reasons, election cadence from formation), live-group iteration (step a), restore rows in F3's table; post-F3 re-measure: Tier 1 not fired, frontier timing +6.7% unresolved, disclosure list in the PR notes; parity SOC-279, divergence 2.146.
